ItemDescription.Value: Calradia Deck Overhaul: Master Armorer & Clan Warband (SteamDeckOverhaul) — A comprehensive standalone overhaul engineered for Steam Deck (SteamOS/Proton) and PC on Bannerlord v1.5.5+. Includes: (1) Master Armorer's 4-Part Modular Armor Smithing Forge, Armor Smelting into Ingots & Field Reforging using real 3D cultural skinned meshes; (2) Point-Based Tier 1-6 Custom Clan Army Architect (15 custom clan troop templates with dynamic point budgets for combat proficiencies, weapons, mounts, and player-forged custom armors); (3) Calradia Diplomatic Courier (remote noble/companion conversations), Mobile Smithing Stamina recovery, Smart Fief Auto-Garrison & Loyalty Manager, and Tactical Battle Overhaul (Two-Handed/Polearm Cleave, Battle Adrenaline Kill-Heal, and Clan Warhorn Rally).
